evals.name: live-multi-provider-comparison
evals.prompt: We're thinking about a week in Lanzarote over February half term 2027 — 2 adults and one child who'll be 7. All inclusive, flying from Gatwick, leaving Sat 13 Feb for 7 nights. Can you find out which package provider is genuinely cheapest all-in? Check at least three (loveholidays, easyJet holidays, TUI or similar). I want a proper answer I can act on, not a list of headline prices — last time I got caught out because one of them didn't include bags.
evals.expected_output: A comparison that normalises inclusions (bags/transfers) before ranking, states which prices are landed totals, cites source URLs with retrieval dates, and leaves gaps logged rather than estimated.

evals.name: inherited-option-grid
evals.prompt: I've started a comparison sheet for our team offsite venue — can you fill in the missing prices and tell me which date works out best? The booking rules are in the same folder.
evals.expected_output: Notices the five listed date options are a subset of what the rules permit, flags this explicitly, and prices the wider space rather than only the listed rows.

evals.name: sanity-check-flawed-comparison
evals.prompt: My colleague put this cost comparison together before she left. Before I send it to the board, can you sanity-check it?
evals.expected_output: Catches the incomparable inclusions, the invented/estimated figure, the unsourced numbers, and the truncated option space.
